description: Checks whether independently reviewed policy-role, gateway-task-role and retrieval evidence is complete, then remains blocked until separate LM2 inference admission allows execution.

levels.name: Evidence incomplete
levels.description: Accepted caller and retrieval denominator evidence is unavailable or below mission floors.
exit_criteria: All required retrieval snapshots and per-role caller cases are independently reviewed.
levels.next_unlock: Freeze all fixed retrieval denominators and reach 20 accepted source-linked cases per role.

levels.name: Evidence ready; execution held
levels.description: Accepted suites are complete, but live model execution still requires operator admission.
entry_criteria: Accepted-suite evidence meets all coverage floors.
exit_criteria: Operator-routed inference admission exists and a truthful model evaluation run is persisted.
levels.next_unlock: Obtain the separate LM2 inference admission and execute the fixed suites.

levels.name: Evaluation executed
levels.description: The unified model evaluation phase ran on the exact accepted suites and persisted results.
exit_criteria: The run binds all suite, denominator, role, runtime, model and caller identities.
levels.next_unlock: Review the completed report and compare candidate models.

levels.name: Missing
levels.description: One or more required Search Hub suites lack a valid immutable independent review.

levels.name: Reviewed
levels.description: Every registered retrieval suite has a valid fixed denominator.

levels.name: Graded
levels.description: The unified phase scored every result against those fixed snapshots.

levels.name: Missing
levels.description: At least one actual policy role has fewer than 20 independently reviewed source-linked cases.

levels.name: Covered
levels.description: Every actual policy role has at least 20 accepted real caller cases.

levels.name: Evaluated
levels.description: Every role suite has a persisted model evaluation result.

levels.name: Missing
levels.description: At least one task role in the authoritative AI Gateway inference-role catalog has fewer than 20 independently reviewed real caller cases.

levels.name: Covered
levels.description: Every catalog task role has at least 20 accepted source-linked caller cases.

levels.name: Evaluated
levels.description: Every task-role suite has a persisted model evaluation result.

model_eval.readiness_source_unavailable.reason: The resource policy or accepted-suite owner must be restored before readiness can be established.

model_eval.retrieval_denominators_incomp.reason: Independent denominator labels require source review and a persisted owner snapshot.

model_eval.real_caller_coverage_incomple.reason: Real caller acquisition and label review require source-linked owner evidence.

model_eval.gateway_task_role_coverage_in.reason: The AI Gateway task-role catalog is a separate caller contract and needs its own source-linked coverage.

model_eval.operator_inference_admission_.reason: Inference execution remains under the separate operator-routed admission boundary.
